message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | # | Step | Description | |---|------|-------------| | 1 | **Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. | | 2 | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (or counterclockwise if a Reverse card is played). | | 3 | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card from your hand that matches the **color** or **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile.
• If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. | | 4 | **Special Cards** | • **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Skip (+S)** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse (+R)** – Reverses the direction of play.
• **Wild (+W)** – You choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+WD4)** – You choose the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | | 5 | **Drawing a Card** | • If you draw a playable card, you may play it immediately.
• If you draw a non‑playable card, your turn ends. | | 6 | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before your opponent takes their turn.
• If you forget and another player calls “UNO” on you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | 7 | **Winning a Round** | The first player to reach **500 points** wins the game. Points are tallied at the end of each round:
• Number cards: face value.
• Draw Two, Skip, Reverse: 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each. | | 8 | **End of Game** | The winner’s score is added to the scores of all other players. The game continues until a player reaches 500 points. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing. | | **Seven-O** | Playing a 7 forces the next player to pick up 7 cards unless they also play a 7. Playing a 0 forces everyone to pass their hands to the next player. | | **Jump-In** | If you have an exact match to the top card, you may play it immediately, even out of turn. | Enjoy playing Uno!
